authority: Static organizational policy for persistent formations and autonomous combined-arms operations. Exact manpower, formations, commanders, casualties, operations, ownership and appointments remain in their native campaign owners.

formation_command_structure.rule: A persistent formation has exactly one commander billet and one deputy billet unless a different exact formation type explicitly overrides that rule. Century/company/wing counts are internal span-of-control markers only; they do not create extra command billets or independent units. New commander/deputy billets exist only after manpower is lawfully split into separate persistent formations. Staff, signal and logistics functions remain included inside the formation's conserved personnel and do not add bodies.

operation_depth.rule: Major state operations should draw several complementary persistent formations when exact available formations and authority permit. The operation layer coordinates them but does not merge their manpower, casualties or ownership.

great_bow_guard.rule: The 3,000-fighter Great Bow Guard is one persistent formation with one commander billet and one deputy billet. Its 15 conserved recruitment cohorts are 200-fighter provenance/manpower slices only and create no command billets. If Tang Wei later splits the Great Bow Guard into multiple persistent formations, each lawful child formation receives its own commander/deputy pair. A separate Sword Manor officer pool may supply staff, signals, logistics, replacements or future commanders without becoming extra formation commanders by default.
